dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave curvature (falcate) from the apex down to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a small radius of curvature, classified as obtuse.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear margin, approximately 70-75 degrees relative to the longitudinal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.8:1, representing a tall, narrow silhouette from the posterior-dorsal perspective.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple faint, linear rake marks (likely intraspecific) visible on the mid-dorsal surface and lateral flanks. A distinct white, circular scar or depigmented lesion is visible on the peduncle immediately anterior to the fluke notch.
other_distinctive_markers: The fluke trailing edges show minor irregular notches and a slight asymmetry in the lobe span.
